summary: Learn to design governed agentic workflows with MCP, controls, and validation. Build practical operations automation skills in 5 days.
lede: Agentic workflow design for operations helps teams structure AI-enabled processes for repeatable execution and exception handling. For operations managers, analysts, automation specialists and process leads, the course covers decomposing tasks, connecting tools through Model Context Protocol (MCP), and defining human checkpoints, escalation paths and validation controls. Participants develop a draft workflow architecture, validation checklist and rollout outline to adapt to their operational needs.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who design, review, govern, or operationalize agentic workflows in business settings. It suits people who need to convert operational needs into traceable AI-enabled processes with controls, tools, and clear handoffs.
prerequisites: You should have working knowledge of operational process design, business analysis, or workflow improvement. Familiarity with AI assistants, basic automation concepts, and process documentation will help, but coding is not required for completion. Participants should bring a laptop and be prepared to work with workflow maps, prompt templates, and scenario-based design exercises; advanced concepts are taught at an operational application level, not as production engineering.
